coordinatePolicy: Blender XYZ to Unity XZY; GLB world XYZ to Unity XY-negativeZ; reflected winding accounted for floor normals
limitations: Source triangle checks are not Unity collision/motor validation.
Air zones contain props; runtime collision avoidance remains authoritative.
Sphere samples are spaced <=1cm and require an extra 5mm clearance margin.
Human support is sampled from solid triangles only; thresholds/edges/capsule penetration require native checks.
No window portals; panes and visible path/cobble/floor boards are non-solid decoration.
